verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers online payments, tokenization, payouts, onboarding, disputes, and webhooks, but contains no mention of physical terminals, card-present/tap-to-pay SDKs, or POS hardware integrations that would let offline/in-person sales settle into the same seller balances as online payments. Since payment platforms plausibly could offer in-person processing, the axis applies, but no evidence supports it.
